note: Set B captures the page's core engineering facts — the 2500 g martensite and 2900 g austenite wire forces, the 400 g total actuation force, the 15–20 C Irvine range, and the 30% heating load — while Set A offers only the 64-louver count plus one chart reading. However, B is noisy: it binds 30% to cooling loads (the text gives 30% heating / 12% cooling), reports the martensite-phase force as "not specified" when 2500 g is stated, misbinds the Irvine ambient 15–20 C range to the actuator assembly and to the building envelope, and repeats the 400 g and 2900 g facts twice. A's chart claim (Ms = -100 C at 53 at.% Ni) is not supported by the plotted data, which ends near 51 at.% Ni, and its caption quote does not support the numeric value. On balance B is more useful because it preserves the actual specifications, despite its misbindings and duplicates.
remarks: Chart reading: the Ms vs Nickel Content scatter appears to stop around 51 at.% Ni, where Ms is roughly -100 C; no data support -100 C at 53 at.% Ni, so Set A's chart claim looks like a misread axis value (and its quote is only the chart caption). Both sets omit the 12 percent cooling-load figure and the fact that each bay carries two mirrored, independently acting assemblies. Several of Set B's quotes are paraphrases rather than verbatim text (e.g. 'during the heating phase' for 'during the heated austenite phase'; '2500 g' for '2500 gram load'), and the same underlying facts are stated under two entity names (Flexinol actuator / actuator assembly / specified wire), inflating the claim count.
